edges.reason: msg.sender supplies the sender argument for transferFrom.
tx.origin is used in the require(recipient == tx.origin) bot gate, a fragile access check.
block.timestamp drives buy/sell windows and cooldown checks in _transfer.
block.timestamp from _launchedAt applies an extra sell-time fee in _getFee.
block.timestamp is passed as deadline in addLiquidityETH.
_launchedAt is set from block.timestamp in openTrading.
msg.sender is forwarded as the from address into _transfer.
block.timestamp passed as swap deadline to the router.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth while processing a sell, before balances are finalized.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee, performing external ETH transfers mid-transaction.
swapTokensForEth invokes the external router swap operation.
The external swap call can re-enter transfer logic via token/pair callbacks.
sendETHToFee triggers native ETH transfers to fee wallets.
ETH transfer to a contract fee wallet can re-enter the contract entry points.
addLiquidity performs the external addLiquidityETH router call.
External router liquidity call could re-enter before uniswapV2Pair is fully trusted.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router for WETH and the swap call.
External swap is executed against the stored router address.
Swap targets the created pair indirectly via router routing.
uniswapV2Pair is read for bot detection and balance-based impact fee.
addLiquidity assigns and uses the router instance.
addLiquidity creates and stores the uniswapV2Pair address.
_tradingOpen gates buy and sell execution in _transfer.
_isExcludedFromFee determines whether fees are taken.
cooldown mapping timestamps are read and written in _transfer.
_isBot freeze check is enforced at the start of _transfer.
_useImpactFeeSetter toggles the contract-balance capping branch.
_feeRate is used to cap contractTokenBalance before swapping.
_maxHeldTokens limits wallet holdings during launch window.
_maxBuyAmount limits buy size during launch window.
_launchedAt anchors all launch-window time comparisons.
_transfer delegates final accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer queries _getFee for the applicable fee.
_tokenTransfer forwards to _transferStandard with computed fee.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to split amount and fee.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam to accrue the team fee.
_takeTeam increments the contract entry of _owned.
_owned[sender] = _owned[sender] - amount balance decrement in _transferStandard.
allowance subtraction in transferFrom derives from the caller-controlled amount.
transferFrom re-approves the reduced allowance via _approve.
approve calls _approve with caller and spender.
ERC20 transfer enters _transfer with msg.sender as from.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the full contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
manualswap restricts execution by comparing msg.sender to _FeeAddress1.
manualsend restricts execution by comparing msg.sender to _FeeAddress1.
Multicall performs an inline msg.sender == _FeeAddress1 authorization.
delBots performs an inline msg.sender == _FeeAddress1 authorization.
setFees authorizes via msg.sender == _FeeAddress1.
setFeeRate combines onlyOwner with msg.sender == _FeeAddress1.
updateFeeAddress1 authorizes against the current _FeeAddress1.
updateFeeAddress2 authorizes against the current _FeeAddress2.
addLiquidity is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier comparing to msg.sender.
openTrading is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
toggleImpactFee is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership writes _owner to the zero address.
updateFeeAddress1 mutates the privileged _FeeAddress1 wallet.
updateFeeAddress2 mutates the privileged _FeeAddress2 wallet.
sendETHToFee pays half the ETH to _FeeAddress1.
sendETHToFee pays half the ETH to _FeeAddress2.
_transferStandard mutates sender and recipient balances in _owned.
transferFrom reads and writes _allowances when recomputing allowance.
Multicall sets _isBot flags for the supplied addresses.
delBots clears _isBot flags for the supplied addresses.
setFees writes _buyFee.
setFees writes _sellFee.
setFeeRate writes _feeRate.
toggleImpactFee writes _useImpactFeeSetter.
openTrading sets _tradingOpen to true.
openTrading sets _launchedAt from block.timestamp.
openTrading initializes _maxBuyAmount.
openTrading initializes _maxHeldTokens.
_getFee writes the local fee value before returning it.
_getFee reads _buyFee for the buy branch.
_getFee reads _sellFee for the sell branch.
_getValues returns transferAmount and team to _transferStandard.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom reads the stored allowance before decrementing.
_transfer reads token balances to evaluate the impact fee cap.
swapTokensForEth depends on the configured router instance.
Sender identity flows into balance mutation through the transfer entrypoints.

normalization_plan.reason: Transient amount argument consumed entirely inside transferFrom accounting.
Sender argument only exists to drive the transferFrom allowance and transfer flow.
Recipient argument is only meaningful within transferFrom and its bot check.
Derived local that directly feeds the allowance subtraction unsafe operation.
from argument scoped to the internal _transfer routine.
to argument scoped to the internal _transfer routine.
amount argument scoped to the internal _transfer routine.
Local balance value is the direct input to the swapTokensForEth call.
Local ETH balance is the direct input to the sendETHToFee call.
Branch flag computed and consumed inside _transfer.
tokenAmount argument only drives the swap amount.
amount argument only drives the split ETH transfers.
Computed fee is the sole return value of the view function.
rate argument writes the _feeRate state variable within setFeeRate.
buy argument maps directly to the _buyFee state write.
sell argument maps directly to the _sellFee state write.
bots_ array is only iterated to set _isBot flags.
bots_ array is only iterated to clear _isBot flags.
newAddress is immediately written into the _FeeAddress1 state variable.
newAddress is immediately written into the _FeeAddress2 state variable.
team argument is added into the contract balance.
amount argument is split into transferAmount and team.
teamFee argument determines the fee portion of the split.
